description: Java entity class representing a product category in an e-commerce system, including fields for hierarchy, descriptions, images, and status.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Entity class for product categories, supporting hierarchy, descriptions, images, and status flags.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the category code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the category code.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the category.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the category.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information for the category.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for the category.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: getCategoryImage
methods.description: Returns the category image URL or path.

methods.name: setCategoryImage
methods.description: Sets the category image URL or path.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the display order of the category.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the category.

methods.name: isCategoryStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the category is active.

methods.name: setCategoryStatus
methods.description: Sets the category's active status.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the category is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the category.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth level of the category in hierarchy.

methods.name: setDepth
methods.description: Sets the depth level of the category.

methods.name: getLineage
methods.description: Returns the lineage string representing hierarchy path.

methods.name: setLineage
methods.description: Sets the lineage string.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent category.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent category.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the associated merchant store.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Sets the merchant store.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of subcategories.

methods.name: setCategories
methods.description: Sets the list of subcategories.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the primary description of the category.
